author: bubbleduo
body:
AniKri is small so it’s mostly takeout and has a different menu every day. They also often have special events on Fridays (dosa night, chicken biryani, Chinese-Indian food, etc). The “mom” is at the counter and the “pop” works in the kitchen. They also sell various batters so you can make your own dosas and such at home.

Awaze is so delicious - get the sampler if you don’t know what to get - but I worry about them because they have so few customers when I go, so am trying to spread the word. I think their location isn’t the best - it’s on the second floor and faces a parking lot, not the street, and it’s surrounded by Indian restaurants so you have to look for it.
